Contemporary technical specifications identify the 2004 Ferrari F1 car and its seven-speed semi-automatic sequential electronic transmission; the local observation identifies the exact AC package.

claims.basis: Contemporary technical specifications identify the 2004 Ferrari F1 car and its seven-speed semi-automatic sequential electronic transmission; the local observation identifies the exact AC package.

Both technical specifications state seven forward gears plus reverse. Both sources explicitly describe a semi-automatic electronically controlled gearbox. The sources describe sequential electronic control; the F2004 cockpit control is paddle-actuated rather than an H-pattern lever. Both sources explicitly use the sequential designation. The reviewed historical summary distinguishes the launch clutch from the semi-automatic running shifts and states that the driver used the clutch to launch. The electronically controlled sequential gearbox performs running gear changes without a driver-operated clutch input; the separate launch-clutch source is consistent with this distinction. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. The semi-automatic sequential gearbox performs running downshifts without a driver-operated clutch input; launch clutch use is a separate function. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shape, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/integrated_display, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shift_lights, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/open_top.
